label: FreeLLMAPI
summary: Self-hosted free-tier gateway: ~30 providers behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
quirks: Local install dependencies: Linux uses Docker/Podman compose; macOS/Windows use the vendor desktop app (no Docker needed there)
First-run setup code and password-reset code appear only in `docker compose logs`; upstream provider keys are added on the web dashboard
Unified key is the only client auth — never expose this port beyond the local machine
Losing ENCRYPTION_KEY (in ~/freellmapi/.env) makes every stored upstream key unrecoverable
The free-tier catalog is a monthly snapshot; /v1/models can list models no key serves
A missing bind-mounted JSON file is created as a directory by Docker → boot loop
Windows: the desktop-app install steps run through Git Bash (the harness executes shell steps with bash) — install Git for Windows first

reuse.label: Use a detected instance
reuse.note: Zero install: uses a FreeLLMAPI instance already running on this device.

local.label: Install locally (Docker or Podman)
deps: Docker Engine or Podman, with Compose
local.diskHint: ~700 MB disk (536 MB image), ~84 MB RAM idle, no GPU

steps.label: Clone FreeLLMAPI
steps.command: if [ -d "{home}/freellmapi" ] && [ ! -d "{home}/freellmapi/.git" ]; then if [ -f "{home}/freellmapi/.env" ]; then echo "Existing {home}/freellmapi/.env found without .git; refusing to wipe it — move the directory aside, then retry" >&2; exit 1; fi; rm -rf "{home}/freellmapi" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; test -d "{home}/freellmapi/.git" || git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi "{home}/freellmapi"

steps.label: Generate ENCRYPTION_KEY
steps.command:
if [ ! -f "{home}/freellmapi/.env" ] || ! grep -qE '^ENCRYPTION_KEY=.+' "{home}/freellmapi/.env"; then printf "ENCRYPTION_KEY=%s
PORT=3002
HOST_BIND=127.0.0.1
" "$(openssl rand -hex 32)" > "{home}/freellmapi/.env"; fi

steps.label: Start the stack
steps.command: ENGINE="$(command -v docker || command -v podman)"; test -n "$ENGINE" || { echo "neither docker nor podman is installed"; exit 1; }; "$ENGINE" compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "podman compose plugin missing (need podman-compose)"; exit 1; }; "$ENGINE" compose up -d

steps.label: Wait for the gateway
steps.command: for i in {1..60}; do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3002/api/ping >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "gateway did not answer within 120s"; exit 1

darwin.label: Install locally (vendor desktop app, no Docker)

steps.label: Download the latest .dmg
steps.command: arch="$(uname -m)"; test "$arch" = arm64 || arch=x64; url="$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi/releases/latest | grep -oE '"browser_download_url": *"[^"]+-'"$arch"'\.dmg"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)"; test -n "$url" || { echo "no FreeLLMAPI $arch .dmg in the latest release"; exit 1; }; mkdir -p "{home}/Downloads"; test -f "{home}/Downloads/FreeLLMAPI.dmg" || curl -fsSL -o "{home}/Downloads/FreeLLMAPI.dmg" "$url"

steps.label: Install the app from the disk image
steps.command: MOUNT="/tmp/freellmapi-dmg-$$"; mkdir -p "$MOUNT"; hdiutil attach "{home}/Downloads/FreeLLMAPI.dmg" -nobrowse -quiet -mountpoint "$MOUNT" && cp -R "$MOUNT"/*.app /Applications/; status=$?; hdiutil detach "$MOUNT" -quiet >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rmdir "$MOUNT" 2>/dev/null || true; exit $status

steps.label: Pin the desktop app to port 3002
steps.command: mkdir -p "{home}/Library/Application Support/FreeLLMAPI" && printf '{"port":3002}\n' > "{home}/Library/Application Support/FreeLLMAPI/config.json"

steps.label: Launch FreeLLMAPI
steps.command: open -a FreeLLMAPI

steps.label: Wait for the gateway
steps.command: for i in {1..60}; do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3002/api/ping >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "gateway did not answer within 120s"; exit 1

win32.label: Install locally (vendor desktop app, no Docker)
deps: Git Bash (the install steps run through bash)

steps.label: Download the latest installer
steps.command: mkdir -p "{home}/Downloads" && curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi/releases/latest | grep -oE '"browser_download_url": *"[^"]+\.exe"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4 > "{home}/Downloads/freellmapi-setup-url"; test -s "{home}/Downloads/freellmapi-setup-url" || { echo "no .exe in the latest release"; exit 1; }; xargs -I{} curl -fsSL -o "{home}/Downloads/FreeLLMAPI-Setup.exe" {} < "{home}/Downloads/freellmapi-setup-url"

steps.label: Install silently
steps.command: cmd //c start //wait "" "$HOME/Downloads/FreeLLMAPI-Setup.exe" /S

steps.label: Pin the desktop app to port 3002
steps.command: mkdir -p "$APPDATA/FreeLLMAPI" && printf '{"port":3002}\n' > "$APPDATA/FreeLLMAPI/config.json"

steps.label: Launch FreeLLMAPI
steps.command: cmd //c start "" "$LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\FreeLLMAPI\FreeLLMAPI.exe"

steps.label: Wait for the gateway
steps.command: for i in {1..60}; do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3002/api/ping >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "gateway did not answer within 120s"; exit 1

steps.label: Stop the stack and drop its volume
steps.command: ENGINE="$(command -v docker || command -v podman)"; test -n "$ENGINE" && "$ENGINE" compose down -v

steps.label: Remove the container image
steps.command: ENGINE="$(command -v docker || command -v podman)"; test -n "$ENGINE" && "$ENGINE" image rm ghcr.io/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi:latest

steps.label: Remove the clone directory
steps.command: rm -rf "{home}/freellmapi"

steps.label: Remove the macOS desktop app and its data
steps.command: test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin || exit 0; pkill -f FreeLLMAPI 2>/dev/null || true; hdiutil detach "/tmp/freellmapi-dmg" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf /Applications/FreeLLMAPI.app "{home}/Library/Application Support/FreeLLMAPI" "{home}/Downloads/FreeLLMAPI.dmg" /tmp/freellmapi-dmg

steps.label: Remove the Windows desktop app and its data
steps.command: case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; taskkill //F //IM FreeLLMAPI.exe 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$APPDATA/FreeLLMAPI" "$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/FreeLLMAPI" "$HOME/Downloads/FreeLLMAPI-Setup.exe"

warnings: `docker compose down -v` deletes volume freellmapi_freellmapi-data — every upstream key and the unified key die with it
~/freellmapi/.env holds ENCRYPTION_KEY; back it up if the volume data is kept anywhere

label: Antigravity Proxy
summary: Multi-account Anthropic-compatible proxy for Google Antigravity OAuth accounts.
requiresBrowser: Adding a Google account is an OAuth flow that opens a browser and waits on a localhost callback — on a headless host the printed URL must be opened from a machine that can reach the callback (e.g. over an SSH port-forward); it cannot be automated
quirks: Local install dependencies: native npm package (Node.js >= 18) behind a systemd or launchd user service on Linux/macOS; Docker is never required. Windows has no supported local install — run the package manually or use a proxy running elsewhere

Linux: the systemd user unit runs the proxy through /bin/bash -lc with PATH ~/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; the package installs under ~/.local/bin, and a Node.js reachable only from an nvm/fnm shell configuration is not found — keep it reachable from a login shell or one of those directories

macOS: the launchd agent runs the proxy through /bin/bash -lc with PATH /opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:~/.local/bin plus the common nvm/fnm node directories; the package installs under ~/.local/bin, and a Node.js reachable only from a fish/zsh/nvm/fnm shell configuration is not found — keep it reachable from a login bash profile or one of those directories
The proxy runs its own sticky account pool with cooldowns — DSH key pooling MUST stay off for this route
The console at :8082 has no auth (webuiPassword empty) — trusted networks only
Quotas are per-account/per-model weekly windows; "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED … resets after 46h" is normal
Other tools on this device may consume the same proxy — removing the service breaks them too

reuse.label: Use a detected instance
reuse.note: Zero install: uses the proxy instance already running on this device and its configured account pool.

local.label: Install locally (npm + user service)
deps: A reachable systemd user session (systemctl --user) on the default path
local.diskHint: ~23 MB install, ~78–150 MB RAM, no GPU

steps.label: Install the proxy package
steps.command: mkdir -p "{home}/.local/bin" && npm install -g --prefix "{home}/.local" antigravity-claude-proxy

steps.label: Write the systemd user unit
steps.command:
mkdir -p {config}/systemd/user && cat > {config}/systemd/user/antigravity-proxy.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Antigravity Claude proxy (per-device)
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Environment=PORT=8082
Environment=HOST=127.0.0.1
Environment=PATH={home}/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
ExecStart=/bin/bash -lc 'BIN="{home}/.local/bin/antigravity-claude-proxy"; test -x "$BIN" || BIN="$(command -v antigravity-claude-proxy)"; exec "$BIN" start --log'
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF

steps.label: Enable and start the unit
steps.command: systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now antigravity-proxy.service

steps.label: Enable lingering (the unit starts without an open login session)
steps.command: loginctl enable-linger "$(id -un)"

steps.label: Wait for the proxy
steps.command: for i in {1..30}; do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8082/health >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "proxy did not answer within 60s"; exit 1

darwin.label: Install locally (npm + launchd agent)
darwin.diskHint: ~23 MB install, ~78–150 MB RAM, no GPU; logs in ~/Library/Logs

steps.label: Install the proxy package
steps.command: mkdir -p "{home}/.local/bin" && npm install -g --prefix "{home}/.local" antigravity-claude-proxy

steps.label: Write the launchd agent
steps.command:
mkdir -p {home}/Library/LaunchAgents {home}/Library/Logs && cat > {home}/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.enpoi.antigravity-proxy.plist <<'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>Label</key>
  <string>dev.enpoi.antigravity-proxy</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>/bin/bash</string>
    <string>-lc</string>
    <string>BIN="{home}/.local/bin/antigravity-claude-proxy"; test -x "$BIN" || BIN="$(command -v antigravity-claude-proxy)"; exec "$BIN" start --log</string>
  </array>
  <key>EnvironmentVariables</key>
  <dict>
    <key>PORT</key>
    <string>8082</string>
    <key>HOST</key>
    <string>127.0.0.1</string>
    <key>PATH</key>
    <string>/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:{home}/.local/bin:{home}/.nvm/versions/node/current/bin:{home}/Library/Application Support/fnm/aliases/default/bin:{home}/.local/share/fnm/aliases/default/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin</string>
  </dict>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key>
  <true/>
  <key>KeepAlive</key>
  <dict>
    <key>SuccessfulExit</key>
    <false/>
  </dict>
  <key>StandardOutPath</key>
  <string>{home}/Library/Logs/antigravity-proxy.log</string>
  <key>StandardErrorPath</key>

</dict>
</plist>
EOF

steps.label: Load and start the agent
steps.command: launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/dev.enpoi.antigravity-proxy 2>/dev/null || true; launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) {home}/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.enpoi.antigravity-proxy.plist 2>/dev/null || launchctl load -w {home}/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.enpoi.antigravity-proxy.plist

steps.label: Wait for the proxy
steps.command: for i in {1..30}; do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8082/health >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "proxy did not answer within 60s"; exit 1

win32.label: Not supported on Windows
win32.unsupported: The antigravity proxy local install needs a POSIX user service (systemd or launchd) to keep the proxy running; this profile has no supported Windows provisioning path. Install the npm package and run `antigravity-claude-proxy` yourself, or run the proxy on another machine and add it as a custom route.

steps.label: Stop and disable the user service
steps.command: if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl --user disable --now antigravity-proxy.service 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if command -v launchctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/dev.enpoi.antigravity-proxy 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if command -v antigravity-claude-proxy >/dev/null 2>&1; then antigravity-claude-proxy stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi

steps.label: Remove the user service file
steps.command: rm -f {config}/systemd/user/antigravity-proxy.service {home}/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.enpoi.antigravity-proxy.plist; if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl --user daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true; fi

steps.label: Uninstall the package from every npm prefix
steps.command: PKG=antigravity-claude-proxy; strip_prefix() { p="$1"; [ -n "$p" ] || return 0; if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm uninstall -g --prefix "$p" "$PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; rm -rf "$p/lib/node_modules/$PKG" "$p/bin/$PKG" 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -L "$p/bin/acc" ]; then case "$(readlink "$p/bin/acc" 2>/dev/null)" in *"$PKG"*) rm -f "$p/bin/acc" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; fi; for stage in "$p"/lib/node_modules/."$PKG"-*; do if [ -e "$stage" ]; then rm -rf "$stage" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; if [ -d "$p/lib/node_modules/$PKG" ] || [ -e "$p/bin/$PKG" ]; then echo "warning: $p still holds $PKG; remove it manually (system prefixes may need sudo): rm -rf $p/lib/node_modules/$PKG $p/bin/$PKG $p/bin/acc"; fi; }; strip_prefix "{home}/.local"; strip_prefix "{home}/.npm-global"; if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then strip_prefix "$(npm prefix -g 2>/dev/null)"; fi; for prefix in "{home}/.nvm/versions/node"/* "{home}/.local/share/nvm/versions/node"/* "{home}/.local/share/fnm/aliases/default" "{home}/Library/Application Support/fnm/aliases/default" "/opt/homebrew"; do if [ -d "$prefix" ]; then strip_prefix "$prefix"; fi; done; for prefix in "/usr/local" "/usr"; do if [ -d "$prefix/lib/node_modules/$PKG" ] || [ -e "$prefix/bin/$PKG" ]; then strip_prefix "$prefix"; fi; done; exit 0

steps.label: Remove the macOS agent logs
steps.command: test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin || exit 0; rm -rf "{home}/Library/Logs/antigravity-proxy"*; exit 0

steps.label: Remove the config directory (accounts.json OAuth tokens, usage history, presets)
steps.command: rm -rf {config}/antigravity-proxy

steps.label: Remove npm npx cache residue
steps.command: rm -rf "{home}/.npm/_npx"/*/node_modules/antigravity-claude-proxy 2>/dev/null || true; exit 0

warnings: Any other tool configured against the same proxy stops working when the service is removed
If a dotfiles/config repository manages the service file (systemd unit or launchd plist), remove it there too or the next sync resurrects it

The proxy state directory ~/.config/antigravity-proxy is deleted in full: accounts.json (every Google OAuth refresh token), usage-history.json, config.json, claude-presets.json, and server-presets.json are unrecoverable afterwards — back them up first if the accounts are shared elsewhere
The Google Antigravity app's own database (~/.config/Antigravity) is only read by the proxy and is never touched by this removal
loginctl lingering is left enabled — it is a per-user setting this teardown does not own
npm's shared content-addressed cache (~/.npm/_cacache) still holds the downloaded tarball; it is shared with other packages, holds no account data, and is left in place
DSH route, credential, pool state, discovered cache, and chain links are removed separately by this teardown

label: Command Code
summary: Command Code's CLI-shaped API at api.commandcode.ai, served by the DSH provider package and its native multi-key pool — no proxy.
quirks: Local install dependencies: Node.js 22 (the setup step links and builds the provider package); Docker is never required, and no proxy or user service runs — the route talks to the vendor directly
The vendor endpoint rejects generic HTTP clients ("Proxy use detected") — the provider package injects the four CLI headers itself; no proxy is required
Keys are managed as pool identities on the Settings → Models Keys card: the route ships one starter identity (COMMANDCODE_KEY_1) and rotates identities in priority order
The vendor account and quota dashboard live at commandcode.ai (browser)
DSH speaks this protocol through the dsh-enpoi-commandcode-provider adapter; llm-pi-ai cannot declare it
Migration: scripts/import-keypool-keys.mjs turns the old keypool pools.json commandcode keys into a settings pool block; it reads the old file but never prints key material
An existing route still pointed at a loopback keypool keeps working until it is switched: set its baseURL to https://api.commandcode.ai, add the imported pool identities, then retire the proxy
The provider package owns the request sanitizer (embedded-base64 scrub, 200k text cap, 413 strip-oldest retry) — clients must not duplicate it

Quota is per key and real: the native pool rotates on exhaustion, and a QUOTA failure ("weekly usage limit" / "insufficient credits") appears only when every pooled identity is spent — a normal state, not a routing defect
A route whose identities resolve no credential fails with MISSING_CREDENTIAL naming the Keys card; there is no anonymous fallback

reuse.label: Use the vendor endpoint now
reuse.note: Writes the route at the vendor endpoint after confirming it answers; run the local setup first when the provider package is not linked yet.

local.label: Link the provider package, then use the vendor endpoint
local.diskHint: ~5 MB provider package; no local service, no GPU

steps.label: Link and build the DSH provider package
steps.command: node "{dshHome}/profiles/web/packages/enpoi-commandcode-provider/scripts/install.mjs" "{dshHome}/profiles/web"

Link the package manually: from the profile root (normally ~/.dsh/profiles/web) run `node packages/enpoi-commandcode-provider/scripts/install.mjs .`, or run the harness on Linux/macOS.

Vendor keys stored under other pool identities (for example COMMANDCODE_KEY_2) are not deleted by removal — delete them on the Keys card
Vendor account state and quota live at commandcode.ai and are never touched

label: Claude Code (Meridian)
summary: Local proxy that serves the operator's Claude subscription through the official Agent SDK as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
requiresBrowser: Signing the Claude Code CLI in to the subscription (`claude auth login --claudeai`) is a browser flow that writes the CLI login store; on a headless host the printed URL must be opened on a machine with a browser
quirks: Local install dependencies: Node.js >= 22 and npm (both packages are global npm installs behind a systemd or launchd user service); Docker is never required, and Windows has no supported local install — run the process manually or point the route at a proxy running elsewhere

The @anthropic-ai/claude-code CLI must be installed and signed in to a Claude subscription (`claude auth login --claudeai`); ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must be unset during that login or the CLI can authenticate against API billing instead
ExecStart must be `node <resolved>/dist/cli.js`, never the `meridian` bin: its `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang does not resolve under systemd
The unit PATH must contain the npm global bin (where `claude` lives), or the Agent SDK cannot spawn the CLI
The model catalog ships inside each Meridian release: /v1/models answers from the build, not from a live CLI query, but an unknown model id still passes through to the SDK
MERIDIAN_ENFORCE_MAX_TOKENS=1 is set here, so a harness that relies on max_tokens gets a hard budget
x-session-affinity is optional and only matters for append-only clients; a request without it runs a fresh SDK session with the history packed into the system prompt
Billing draws from the operator's own Claude subscription usage windows (like `claude -p`) — Meridian drives the official CLI/SDK and never reads or replays OAuth tokens

reuse.label: Use a detected instance
reuse.note: Zero install: uses a Meridian proxy already running on this device and its Claude subscription login.

local.label: Install locally (npm + user service)
deps: A reachable systemd user session (systemctl --user) on the default path
local.diskHint: Two global npm packages and one Node process; no GPU, no Docker

steps.label: Check Node.js and npm
steps.command: command -v node >/dev/null && command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "Meridian needs Node.js >= 22 with npm on PATH"; exit 1; }; major="$(node -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]')"; [ "$major" -ge 22 ] || { echo "Meridian needs Node.js >= 22 (found $(node -v))"; exit 1; }

steps.label: Install the Claude Code CLI when it is missing or older than 2.1.293
steps.command: GLOBAL_BIN="$(npm prefix -g)/bin" && export PATH="$GLOBAL_BIN:$PATH"; have="$(claude --version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1)"; if [ -n "$have" ] && node -e 'const [a,b,c]=process.argv[1].split(".").map(Number); process.exit(a>2||(a===2&&(b>1||(b===1&&c>=293)))?0:1)' "$have"; then echo "Claude Code CLI $have is installed"; else npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code; fi

steps.label: Require a Claude subscription login
steps.command: GLOBAL_BIN="$(npm prefix -g)/bin" && export PATH="$GLOBAL_BIN:$PATH"; env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN claude auth status 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"claude.ai"' || { echo "the Claude Code CLI is not signed in to a Claude subscription"; echo "run: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY claude auth login --claudeai"; echo "then re-run this install"; exit 1; }

steps.label: Install Meridian
steps.command: npm install -g @rynfar/meridian@latest

steps.label: Write the systemd user unit
steps.command:
mkdir -p {config}/systemd/user && NODE_BIN="$(command -v node)" && GLOBAL_BIN="$(npm prefix -g)/bin" && ENTRY="$(node -e 'console.log(require("fs").realpathSync(process.argv[1]))' "$(npm root -g)/@rynfar/meridian/dist/cli.js")" || { echo "could not resolve @rynfar/meridian/dist/cli.js under $(npm root -g 2>/dev/null); run the Meridian install step first"; exit 1; }; cat > {config}/systemd/user/meridian.service <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Meridian — standalone API bridge for the Claude subscription (official Agent SDK)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
# node plus the resolved cli.js: the bin's #!/usr/bin/env node shebang does not resolve here
ExecStart=$NODE_BIN $ENTRY
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10s
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
Environment=HOME=%h
Environment=MERIDIAN_HOST=127.0.0.1
Environment=MERIDIAN_PORT=3456
Environment=MERIDIAN_PASSTHROUGH=1
Environment=MERIDIAN_ENFORCE_MAX_TOKENS=1
# the Agent SDK spawns claude, which lives in the npm global bin
Environment=PATH=$GLOBAL_BIN:{home}/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF

steps.label: Enable and start the unit
steps.command: systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now meridian.service

steps.label: Wait for Meridian
steps.command: for i in {1..30}; do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3456/health >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "Meridian did not answer /health within 60s — check the user service log (systemctl --user status meridian.service, or launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/dev.meridian.proxy)"; exit 1

steps.label: Check Node.js and npm
steps.command: command -v node >/dev/null && command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "Meridian needs Node.js >= 22 with npm on PATH"; exit 1; }; major="$(node -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]')"; [ "$major" -ge 22 ] || { echo "Meridian needs Node.js >= 22 (found $(node -v))"; exit 1; }

steps.label: Install the Claude Code CLI when it is missing or older than 2.1.293
steps.command: GLOBAL_BIN="$(npm prefix -g)/bin" && export PATH="$GLOBAL_BIN:$PATH"; have="$(claude --version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1)"; if [ -n "$have" ] && node -e 'const [a,b,c]=process.argv[1].split(".").map(Number); process.exit(a>2||(a===2&&(b>1||(b===1&&c>=293)))?0:1)' "$have"; then echo "Claude Code CLI $have is installed"; else npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code; fi

steps.label: Require a Claude subscription login
steps.command: GLOBAL_BIN="$(npm prefix -g)/bin" && export PATH="$GLOBAL_BIN:$PATH"; env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN claude auth status 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"claude.ai"' || { echo "the Claude Code CLI is not signed in to a Claude subscription"; echo "run: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY claude auth login --claudeai"; echo "then re-run this install"; exit 1; }

steps.label: Install Meridian
steps.command: npm install -g @rynfar/meridian@latest

steps.label: Write the systemd user unit
steps.command:
mkdir -p {config}/systemd/user && NODE_BIN="$(command -v node)" && GLOBAL_BIN="$(npm prefix -g)/bin" && ENTRY="$(node -e 'console.log(require("fs").realpathSync(process.argv[1]))' "$(npm root -g)/@rynfar/meridian/dist/cli.js")" || { echo "could not resolve @rynfar/meridian/dist/cli.js under $(npm root -g 2>/dev/null); run the Meridian install step first"; exit 1; }; cat > {config}/systemd/user/meridian.service <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Meridian — standalone API bridge for the Claude subscription (official Agent SDK)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
# node plus the resolved cli.js: the bin's #!/usr/bin/env node shebang does not resolve here
ExecStart=$NODE_BIN $ENTRY
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10s
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
Environment=HOME=%h
Environment=MERIDIAN_HOST=127.0.0.1
Environment=MERIDIAN_PORT=3456
Environment=MERIDIAN_PASSTHROUGH=1
Environment=MERIDIAN_ENFORCE_MAX_TOKENS=1
# the Agent SDK spawns claude, which lives in the npm global bin
Environment=PATH=$GLOBAL_BIN:{home}/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF

steps.label: Enable and start the unit
steps.command: systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now meridian.service

steps.label: Wait for Meridian
steps.command: for i in {1..30}; do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3456/health >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "Meridian did not answer /health within 60s — check the user service log (systemctl --user status meridian.service, or launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/dev.meridian.proxy)"; exit 1

darwin.label: Install locally (npm + launchd agent)
darwin.diskHint: Two global npm packages and one Node process; no GPU, no Docker; logs in ~/Library/Logs

steps.label: Check Node.js and npm
steps.command: command -v node >/dev/null && command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "Meridian needs Node.js >= 22 with npm on PATH"; exit 1; }; major="$(node -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]')"; [ "$major" -ge 22 ] || { echo "Meridian needs Node.js >= 22 (found $(node -v))"; exit 1; }

steps.label: Install the Claude Code CLI when it is missing or older than 2.1.293
steps.command: GLOBAL_BIN="$(npm prefix -g)/bin" && export PATH="$GLOBAL_BIN:$PATH"; have="$(claude --version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1)"; if [ -n "$have" ] && node -e 'const [a,b,c]=process.argv[1].split(".").map(Number); process.exit(a>2||(a===2&&(b>1||(b===1&&c>=293)))?0:1)' "$have"; then echo "Claude Code CLI $have is installed"; else npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code; fi

steps.label: Require a Claude subscription login
steps.command: GLOBAL_BIN="$(npm prefix -g)/bin" && export PATH="$GLOBAL_BIN:$PATH"; env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN claude auth status 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"claude.ai"' || { echo "the Claude Code CLI is not signed in to a Claude subscription"; echo "run: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY claude auth login --claudeai"; echo "then re-run this install"; exit 1; }

steps.label: Install Meridian
steps.command: npm install -g @rynfar/meridian@latest

steps.label: Write the launchd agent
steps.command:
mkdir -p {home}/Library/LaunchAgents {home}/Library/Logs && NODE_BIN="$(command -v node)" && GLOBAL_BIN="$(npm prefix -g)/bin" && ENTRY="$(node -e 'console.log(require("fs").realpathSync(process.argv[1]))' "$(npm root -g)/@rynfar/meridian/dist/cli.js")" || { echo "could not resolve @rynfar/meridian/dist/cli.js under $(npm root -g 2>/dev/null); run the Meridian install step first"; exit 1; }; cat > {home}/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.meridian.proxy.plist <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>Label</key>
  <string>dev.meridian.proxy</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>$NODE_BIN</string>
    <string>$ENTRY</string>
  </array>
  <key>EnvironmentVariables</key>
  <dict>
    <key>HOME</key>
    <string>{home}</string>
    <key>MERIDIAN_HOST</key>
    <string>127.0.0.1</string>
    <key>MERIDIAN_PORT</key>
    <string>3456</string>
    <key>MERIDIAN_PASSTHROUGH</key>
    <string>1</string>
    <key>MERIDIAN_ENFORCE_MAX_TOKENS</key>
    <string>1</string>
    <key>PATH</key>
    <string>$GLOBAL_BIN:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin</string>
  </dict>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key>
  <true/>
  <key>KeepAlive</key>
  <true/>
  <key>StandardOutPath</key>
  <string>{home}/Library/Logs/meridian.log</string>
  <key>StandardErrorPath</key>
  <string>{home}/Library/Logs/meridian.err.log</string>
</dict>
</plist>
EOF

steps.label: Load and start the agent
steps.command: launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/dev.meridian.proxy 2>/dev/null || true; launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) {home}/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.meridian.proxy.plist 2>/dev/null || launchctl load -w {home}/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.meridian.proxy.plist; launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/dev.meridian.proxy

steps.label: Wait for Meridian
steps.command: for i in {1..30}; do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3456/health >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "Meridian did not answer /health within 60s — check the user service log (systemctl --user status meridian.service, or launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/dev.meridian.proxy)"; exit 1

win32.label: Not supported on Windows
win32.unsupported: The Meridian local install needs a POSIX user service (systemd or launchd) to keep the proxy running; this profile has no supported Windows provisioning path. Install Node.js 22, run `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code` and sign in with `env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY claude auth login --claudeai`, then `npm install -g @rynfar/meridian` and start `node <npm root -g>/@rynfar/meridian/dist/cli.js` yourself with MERIDIAN_HOST=127.0.0.1, MERIDIAN_PORT=3456, MERIDIAN_PASSTHROUGH=1 and MERIDIAN_ENFORCE_MAX_TOKENS=1 — or point the route at a Meridian proxy running elsewhere.

steps.label: Stop and disable the user service
steps.command: if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl --user disable --now meridian.service 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if command -v launchctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/dev.meridian.proxy 2>/dev/null || true; fi

steps.label: Remove the user service file
steps.command: rm -f {config}/systemd/user/meridian.service {home}/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.meridian.proxy.plist; if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl --user daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true; fi

steps.label: Remove the macOS agent logs
steps.command: test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin || exit 0; rm -f "{home}/Library/Logs/meridian.log" "{home}/Library/Logs/meridian.err.log"; exit 0

steps.label: Leave the global npm packages installed (@rynfar/meridian and @anthropic-ai/claude-code are not uninstalled)
steps.command: echo "Meridian and the Claude Code CLI stay installed; remove them yourself with: npm uninstall -g @rynfar/meridian @anthropic-ai/claude-code"

warnings: Meridian and the Claude Code CLI stay installed as npm global packages — uninstall them yourself when no other tool uses them
~/.config/meridian (profiles, settings, model pricing) and ~/.cache/meridian (sessions) are left in place; they hold no credentials, but delete them by hand if the install is not coming back
The Claude CLI login store (~/.claude) belongs to the CLI and is never touched by this removal
Any other tool pointed at the proxy stops working when the service is removed
If a dotfiles/config repository manages the unit file (systemd unit or launchd plist), remove it there too or the next sync resurrects it
Turns already served drew from the Claude subscription usage windows and are not refunded
